Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task’s timing criterion by checking whether directors had ever held C‑suite roles rather than whether they held C‑suite positions at the time they joined Apple’s board. This led to the incorrect conclusion that none fit the criterion, overlooking that Wanda Austin, Ronald D. Sugar, and Susan L. (Sue) Wagner were not in C‑suite roles when they were appointed.
